name: siggi's Plant-Based Coconut Blend Vanilla Yogurt
whyItWorks: Made from a blend of coconut milk, macadamia nut milk, and pea protein, fermented with live active cultures. Delivers 10g protein with 0g dairy lactose and very low sugar, offering rich creaminess for strict dairy-free diets.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Keep refrigerated. Stir well before eating.
